display.purpose: Page titles, card headlines, headline figures.

body.purpose: Labels, table cells, nav, body copy, chat.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: The soft ambient shadow every card floats on.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid charcoal button, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Public Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 11px; background: #23262b; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 18px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -6px rgba(35,38,43,0.35); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Cream outline button — Export CSV, secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: 'Public Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 11px; background: #f5f7f3; color: #23262b; border: 1px solid #e6eae5; padding: 9px 16px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e6eae5; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The base container for every stat, chart, and table on every page.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid #e6eae5; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(35,38,43,0.04), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(35,38,43,0.10); padding: 24px; }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Business-account flag switch on Connect Bank.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; width: 38px; height: 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e6eae5; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle[data-on='true'] { background: #00bf63; } .ds-toggle::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-toggle[data-on='true']::after { transform: translateX(16px); }

components.name: Table
components.description: Card-embedded data table — no zebra striping, line-colored row dividers.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: 'Public Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-table th { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7c8289; text-align: left; padding: 0 0 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e6eae5; } .ds-table td { padding: 13px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e6eae5; font-size: 13.5px; color: #23262b; } .ds-amount { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar page link — icon + label, full-pill radius, solid green when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Public Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #7c8289; background: transparent; } .ds-nav-item[data-active='true'] { background: #00bf63; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Chat Bubble
components.description: Insights conversation bubble, user vs. assistant.
components.html: Ask about your real accounts, spending, budgets, and forecast.
components.css: .ds-bubble-user { background: #23262b; color: #fff; border-radius: 16px 16px 4px 16px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 13.5px; } .ds-bubble-assistant { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6eae5; color: #23262b; border-radius: 16px 16px 16px 4px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 13.5px; }

narrative.northStar: Charts as the Centerpiece, Branded in Green and Blue
narrative.overview: Maibanc replaced its first shipped identity — a bound-ledger, zero-radius, ruled-table system — with a card-based, chart-forward system at the user's explicit direction, using Monarch Money as a named reference and then deliberately differentiating it on Maibanc's own brand colors rather than a generic soft-SaaS palette. Every page is a set of white, generously-rounded cards floating on a cool cream ground; real charts carry the story on every page. Nothing is fabricated — every chart and figure reflects real Plaid data, real IRS/FTB tax brackets, or an honest 'not available' state.
keyCharacteristics: Cool cream background holding white cards with soft layered shadows and 18px radius.
Maibanc's real brand green is the system's primary voice; brand blue is secondary; gold/violet/coral fill out multi-category charts.
Bricolage Grotesque carries every heading and headline figure; Public Sans carries labels, tables, and body text.
Every chart renders with isAnimationActive={false} — data is legible on first paint.

rules.name: The One Negative Rule
rules.body: Coral is the system's only negative/warning color — losses, over-budget bars, liabilities, destructive actions. It never appears as a decorative or category-neutral color.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: Every rendered dollar figure uses tabular-nums and is right-aligned in tables.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is ambient (blur, low opacity, no hard offset). No hard-offset block shadows.

dos: Do lead every page with a real chart or headline figure, not a row of identical icon-plus-text cards.
Do keep green exclusive to positive/primary meaning and coral exclusive to negative/destructive meaning.
Do set isAnimationActive={false} on every recharts element.
Do color multi-series charts with <Cell>, never a raw SVG element.
Do show an honest empty/unavailable state rather than fabricating data.
donts: Don't introduce a new accent color outside green/blue/gold/violet/coral without updating this system deliberately.
Don't use a hard-offset shadow anywhere in this system.
Don't let a chart's entrance animation be the only way data becomes visible.
Don't reintroduce the prior ledger system's zero-radius, ruled-table language on a new page.
